S42.01.needs: a Basic or higher paid plan (scheduled tasks are hidden on Free)
S42.01.note: The UI has no briefing-specific control; a daily briefing is a Daily scheduled task with a prompt. Delivery to the user was not verified.
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the left sidebar.
Click "New task" (or "Create Your First Schedule" if the list is empty).
Type a prompt, set "Frequency" to "Daily", set "Local Time" and "Time Zone", then click "Create Schedule".
Look for the new task card in the list showing "Every day at" and the time you set. Compare with Expected: a recurring daily task that is generated and delivered.

S42.04.needs: a Basic or higher paid plan
S42.04.note: The card's time text is built in ScheduleCard.tsx; the ScheduleForm line the Code audit cited was not re-checked.
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the left sidebar.
Click "New task", then set "Frequency" to "Daily".
Change "Local Time" and open "Time Zone" and pick a different zone.
Click "Create Schedule" and check the card shows "Every day at" with the time you chose. Compare with Expected.
S42.04.where: Scheduled > New task > Local Time and Time Zone

S42.15.needs: a task that already exists (create one first)
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the left sidebar.
On a task card, click the "Pause" button, or flip its switch labelled "Pause" with the task name.
Look for the card to show "Paused" and the button to change to "Resume".
Click "Resume" and check the card returns to its active state. Compare with Expected.

S42.16.needs: a notification channel turned on (for example mobile push) to see the effect
S42.16.note: The holding of notifications is inner behaviour; only the settings are visible. The quoted code in push-notification-service and job-handlers was not found, so the hold logic was not confirmed.
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Time and focus".
Turn on the "Quiet hours" switch, pick days, set the start and end times.
Click "Save changes".
Check the saved times stay after reload. Whether proactive notifications are held during those hours needs a phone or push check and was not verified in the code.
S42.16.where: Settings > Time and focus > Quiet hours

S42.17.needs: an email or mobile push channel reachable from the account; a scheduled task to run
S42.17.note: Agent-run updates are a separate block titled "Agent run updates" in the same section; the delivery itself was not verified.
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Notifications".
Find the row "Scheduled task finished" ("When a scheduled task completes or fails.") and turn on its Email or mobile push channel.
Run a scheduled task (for example "Run now" from its card) and wait for it to finish.
Check that the chosen channel receives a notice saying the task finished. Compare with Expected.

S42.19.needs: some conversation history; the page may ask for memory to be on
S42.19.note: The error text the Code line quoted was not found, so the error and memory-required messages were only checked in use-reflect-recap.ts.
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Reflect".
Look at the heading "Reflect" and the activity chart below it.
Change the range in the "Reflect range" dropdown, for example "Past 30 days" to "Past 3 months".
Check the recap updates for that range. Compare with Expected.

S42.21.needs: conversation history spanning the past year, ideally
S42.21.note: There is no separate annual-recap screen; it is the "Past year" option on the Reflect page.
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Reflect".
Open the "Reflect range" dropdown and choose "Past year".
Look at the recap and activity chart, which should cover the last 365 days.
Compare with Expected: a recap of the past year.

S42.22.needs: a few minutes of active use
S42.22.note: The reminder itself is shown by apps/web/features/time-focus/TimeFocusReminder.tsx; its visible text was not checked.
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Time and focus".
Open the "Break reminder" dropdown and choose an interval such as "30 minutes".
Click "Save changes", then keep using the app until the interval has passed.
Look for a break reminder to appear in the app. Compare with Expected. The exact reminder wording was not confirmed.
S42.22.where: Settings > Time and focus > Break reminder

S42.23.note: The page title shown in the code is "Time and focus" (TimeFocusSection.tsx), not "Time & focus".
steps: Open "Settings" from the account menu, then click "Time and focus".
Look for the "Break reminder" dropdown and the "Quiet hours" section with its switch.
Change a value, then click "Save changes".
Close and reopen Settings and check the values stayed. Compare with Expected.

S42.25.needs: a task that has run at least once
S42.25.note: The Recent results section appears only when at least one schedule exists; Run History is referenced in ScheduleCard.tsx.
steps: Click "Scheduled" in the left sidebar.
Scroll below the task list to the "Recent results" heading.
Open a result row to see the saved output of an earlier run.
Compare with Expected: past briefings and outputs are kept and can be browsed. Run History is also reachable from a task card.
